name: Halls
rule: Stone corridors, stairs, and classrooms. Easy going, but every door may be watched.

name: Grounds
rule: Lawns, playing fields, and paths. Easy going on foot.

name: Lake
rule: Open water. Nothing crosses it on foot; the way round follows the shore.

name: Forest
rule: Forest without a path. Tough going on foot, and easy to lose the school behind you.

name: Village Streets
rule: Cobbled streets and lanes between the houses. Easy going on foot.

name: Ruins
rule: Broken walls and old foundations. Tough going, and full of things the school left behind.

name: Courtyard
rule: Paved courts and cloisters. Easy going, and a good place to meet between lessons.

name: River
rule: Flowing water. Cross at the bridge or the stepping stones; the banks are easy going.

name: Meadow
rule: Flower meadow and soft grass. Easy going, and good ground for familiars.

name: Gardens
rule: Walled herb beds and gravel paths. Easy going, but some plants are not for picking.

name: Orchard
rule: Rows of fruit trees and mown grass. Easy going between the trunks.

name: Pinewood
rule: Dark conifer forest. Tough going, and easy to lose the school behind you.

name: Hills
rule: Rolling hills above the school. Tough going, with a view of the whole campus.

name: Marsh
rule: Reedy marsh behind the grounds. Perilous going, and full of small lights at night.
